literal: The state of having separated, abundantly they announce, it seems: the united day swelled shoulders.
translation: My shoulders, which swelled with joy on the day we united, now seem to clearly announce his departure.
modern: நாம் கூடியிருந்த நாளில் மகிழ்ச்சியால் பூரித்திருந்த என் தோள்கள், இப்போது மெலிந்து அவர் என்னை விட்டுப் பிரிந்து சென்றதை ஊராருக்குத் தெளிவாக அறிவிக்கின்றன.
explanation: The heroine laments the physical toll of her lover's absence. She contrasts her current state with the day they united, when her shoulders swelled with joy. Now, those same shoulders have grown so thin that they seem to loudly announce his departure to everyone. The word 'வீங்கிய' (swelled) highlights the past joy, making the present wasting away of her shoulders an undeniable proof of her loneliness.
